cases.purpose: Reject signed wrong and unknown ELF machines even with an any architecture manifest
cases.oracle: Independent USTAR archives, GNU gcc ELF, and OpenSSL Ed25519 signatures and verification. All inputs, keys, hooks, installed state, and roots are fixture-only; setup validates the archive encoder, signatures, ELF, and GNU Bash module loading.
cases.comparison: Exact normalized observations, statuses, expected fixture files, and bounded raw output/diagnostic files; no candidate behavior is treated as oracle. Public keys, signed package bytes, signatures, and per-control verification results are retained; private keys are excluded.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-pkg-fixtures-r2.py
mkdir -p root
"$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'enable -f "$1" fixtureprobe && fixtureprobe && enable -d fixtureprobe' control "$HOME/pkg-fixture/probe.so" > "$HOME/control-module.out" 2> "$HOME/control-module.err" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED reference cannot load fixture module'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/pkg-machine-regression.py
cases.candidate_script:
export BASHSIGNIFY_TRUSTED_KEYS_DIR="$HOME/pkg-fixture/trusted" BASHSIGNIFY_REVOKED_KEYS="$HOME/pkg-fixture/not-revoked"
F="$HOME/pkg-fixture"
for name in valid bad-machine bad-machine-any bad-machine-zero; do
  builtin pkg verify "$F/$name.pkg" --root root > "$HOME/$name.out" 2> "$HOME/$name.err"
  rc=$?
  if /usr/bin/grep -q 'loadable ELF machine mismatch' "$HOME/$name.err"; then diag=yes; else diag=no; fi
  printf '%s status=%s machine-diagnostic=%s\n' "$name" "$rc" "$diag"
done
cases.stdout:
valid status=0 machine-diagnostic=no
bad-machine status=1 machine-diagnostic=yes
bad-machine-any status=1 machine-diagnostic=yes
bad-machine-zero status=1 machine-diagnostic=yes
